mapper.sql: id, direction, partner_id, term_days, term_basis, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT p.*,c.name partner_name FROM fin_profile p JOIN customer c ON c.id=p.partner_id WHERE p.direction='AR' AND #{direction}='AR' UNION ALL SELECT p.*,s.name partner_name FROM fin_profile p JOIN supplier s ON s.id=p.partner_id WHERE p.direction='AP' AND #{direction}='AP' ORDER BY partner_id
SELECT * FROM fin_profile WHERE direction=#{direction} AND partner_id=#{partnerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_profile (direction,partner_id,term_days,term_basis) VALUES (#{direction},#{partnerId},#{termDays},#{termBasis}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE term_days=VALUES(term_days),term_basis=VALUES(term_basis)
mapper.select: SELECT id,name,short_name FROM customer WHERE #{direction}='AR' UNION ALL SELECT id,name,short_name FROM supplier WHERE #{direction}='AP' ORDER BY id
